US Labor Department tells court it will set new H-2A wage rates by 30 December

After a federal court ruled that the 2025 change to the H-2A wage method was unlawful, the Department of Labor told the court it is working to publish replacement wage rates by the court's 30 December 2026 deadline.
US court rules the H-2A wage cut unlawful

In a case brought by the United Farm Workers, a federal court in Fresno held that the Labor Department's new method for setting H-2A guest-worker wages, which cut pay by up to $7 an hour, was unlawful.
US Labor Department rescinds 1980 rule on coordinating protections for migrant farmworkers
The Department of Labor revoked a 1980 regulation on coordinating the enforcement of legal protections for migrant and seasonal farmworkers.
EU Pact on Migration and Asylum applies from today
The package of EU regulations on asylum procedures, screening at external borders, Eurodac and solidarity between member states entered into application.
Deadline passes for the recast EU Single Permit Directive
Member states had to transpose Directive (EU) 2024/1233, which gives third-country workers a single work and residence permit, equal treatment and a right to change employer.
South Korea suspends seasonal farmworker recruitment from four Thai provinces
Korea halted recruitment under its seasonal worker scheme from Khon Kaen, Udon Thani, Chaiyaphum and Maha Sarakham.
South Korea plans mandatory insurance and safety checks for migrant farmworkers
The government announced plans for compulsory insurance and safety checklists covering migrant workers on farms.
Indonesia passes the Domestic Workers Protection Law
After more than two decades of campaigning, Indonesia's House of Representatives passed a law protecting domestic workers.
